description.value: Mountain Burger House is a classic downtown Squamish diner on Cleveland Ave, positioned directly off Highway 99 and well-placed for cyclists traveling the Sea-to-Sky corridor. It serves a broad all-day breakfast menu spanning bacon-and-eggs, skillets, omelets, and fresh-baked pastries, alongside burgers and lunch specials. Both indoor and outdoor seating are available, and a Friday evening buffet gives it a distinct local character.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at mountainburgerhouse.com is clearly the same business as OSM 'MBH Diner' (MBH = Mountain Burger House), confirmed by the Squamish location on Cleveland Ave off Highway 99. The website provides a full menu, active 'Order Now' online ordering, and explicit vegetarian menu items (Veggie Omelet, Vegetarian Skillet, Vegetable Quiche), plus contact details not present in OSM. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or charging appears anywhere on the site.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records the business as 'MBH Diner' but the website consistently uses 'Mountain Burger House'; name updated to the website value per rule 12.
Minor postal code discrepancy between website subpages: /cart footer shows V8B 0B4 while /contact page body shows V8B 0L4; used V8B 0B4 as it appears in the consistent site-wide footer.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active diner in central Squamish with a functioning website, full menu, and online ordering; a practical fuel stop for cyclists on the Sea-to-Sky route.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu includes Veggie Omelet, Vegetarian Skillet, Vegetable Quiche, and Granola & Yogurt
